title: Git tag name too long for DB
body:
### Description

I have a repo that I want to push into Gitea, the project has branches and tags.

➜  H5hut git:(master) git push --mirror

On the Server side is see this log:

2025/07/21 13:15:59 services/issue/commit.go:126:UpdateIssuesCommit() [W] Repository referenced in commit but does not exist: repository does not exist [id: 0, uid: 0, owner_name: h5hut, name: src]
2025/07/21 13:16:00 services/repository/push.go:41:handler() [E] pushUpdate[bruhn_b/5Huete] failed: PushUpdateAddDeleteTags: Insert: pq: value too long for type character varying(255)

### Gitea Version

1.24.3

No
